```{r}

elev_z_flux_clean <- elev_z_flux |> 
  filter(Flux > 0)  # removes negatives and zeros

# Double check it worked
sum(elev_z_flux_clean$Flux <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)  # should return 0
summary(elev_z_flux_clean$Flux)


# 1. Test if slopes are significantly different between morphology types
library(lme4)
model <- lmer(log(Flux) ~ z_star * marsh_edge_type + (1|Site) + (1|Study.Phase), 
              data = elev_z_flux_clean)
summary(model)

# 1. Get p-values formally
library(lmerTest)
model_full <- lmer(log(Flux) ~ z_star * marsh_edge_type + 
                     (1 | Site) + (1 | Study.Phase),  
                   data = elev_z_flux_clean,
                   REML = FALSE)
summary(model_full)  # lmerTest will now show p-values

# 2. Calculate R-squared
library(MuMIn)
r.squaredGLMM(model_full)
# R2m = variance explained by fixed effects only
# R2c = variance explained by entire model including random effects

# 3. Get predicted slopes per edge type for reporting
library(emmeans)
emtrends(model_full, ~ marsh_edge_type, var = "z_star")


# 1. Get formal p-values for reporting
library(lmerTest)
summary(model_full)

# 2. Get R-squared values
library(MuMIn)
r.squaredGLMM(model_full)

# 3. Plot the predicted trends cleanly for a publication figure
library(ggeffects)
pred <- ggpredict(model_full, terms = c("z_star [all]", "marsh_edge_type"))

ggplot(pred, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_point(data = elev_z_flux_clean, 
             aes(x = z_star, y = log(Flux), color = marsh_edge_type),
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Ramped" = "#E69F00", "Scarped" = "#0072B2")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Ramped" = "#E69F00", "Scarped" = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(x = "z*", 
       y = "log(Sediment Flux g/m²)",
       color = "Edge Type", 
       fill  = "Edge Type",
       title = "Sediment Deposition by Marsh Edge Morphology") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

```{r, derive Month for reference models}

## Append these chunks to the END of master_thesis_regressions.Rmd,
## after its existing final chunk (the ggpredict plot).
##
## Adapted from Pre-Research_Questions.qmd and Research_Questions.qmd,
## both marked reference-only in Session_Status. Rebuilt against
## master_tier5 directly -- this file is thesis-only by design, and
## master_tier5 never had USGS data to filter out in the first place,
## so the "drop USGS" step both source files did isn't needed here.
##
## Left out entirely, per your call:
##   - Research_Questions.qmd's marshedge object: filtered to
##     thesis-only on one line, then immediately overwritten by an
##     unfiltered version on the next line -- dead code either way.
##   - Research_Questions.qmd's marsh_edge_model_time chunk (the two
##     emmeans() plots) -- that model is never actually built anywhere,
##     in this file or its predecessor. Would error if included.
##   - A leftover combined <- read_excel(...) call pointing at an
##     unrelated desktop path, whose result was never used again.
##
## Built on the FULL master_tier5 (all M1-M12), not the M1-M6-only
## subset both source files used -- confirmed that was just a function
## of partial data at the time, not an intentional restriction.
# Same derivation and chronological ordering (July start) as
# usgs_thesis_merge.qmd, for consistency across the pipeline.

study_month_levels <- c("July", "August", "September", "October",
                        "November", "December", "January", "February",
                        "March", "April", "May", "June")

master_tier5 <- master_tier5 %>%
  mutate(Month = factor(month(Date.removed.from.field, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
                        levels = study_month_levels, ordered = TRUE))
```

 

```{r, distance model prep}
# From Pre-Research_Questions.qmd's avgdist -- Flux averaged per
# Dist x Site x Tran combination.

avgdist <- aggregate(Flux ~ Dist + Site + Tran, data = master_tier5, FUN = mean)
avgdist$Dist <- factor(avgdist$Dist, levels = c(0.5, 2, 6, 12, 18, 24, 48))

shapiro.test(avgdist$Flux)
shapiro.test(log(avgdist$Flux))

qqnorm(avgdist$Flux)
qqline(avgdist$Flux)

```

```{r, distance models}
distmodel <- glmer(Flux ~ Dist + (1|Site) + (1|Tran), data = avgdist)
summary(distmodel)

logdistmodel <- lmer(log(Flux) ~ Dist + (1|Site) + (1|Tran), data = avgdist)
summary(logdistmodel)

plot(logdistmodel)        # residuals vs fitted
qqnorm(resid(logdistmodel))
qqline(resid(logdistmodel))

# Outlier check
outliers <- which(abs(scale(resid(logdistmodel))) > 2.5)
distmodel_no_outliers <- lmer(log(Flux) ~ Dist + (1|Site) + (1|Tran),
                              data = avgdist[-outliers, ])
summary(logdistmodel)
summary(distmodel_no_outliers)

distmodelcont <- lmer(log(Flux) ~ Dist + (1|Site) + (1|Tran), data = avgdist)
summary(distmodelcont)
```

```{r, distance x site model and plots}
  distsitemodel <- lmer(log(Flux) ~ Dist + Site + Dist*Site + (1|Tran), data = avgdist)
summary(distsitemodel)

avgdist$predicted <- predict(distsitemodel)
preds <- ggpredict(distsitemodel, terms = c("Dist [all]", "Site"), back.transform = FALSE)

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = avgdist,
             aes(x = Dist, y = log(Flux), colour = Site, shape = Site),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = preds,
            aes(x = x, y = predicted, colour = group, group = group),
            linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(data = preds,
              aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = group, group = group),
              alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(x = "Distance (m)", y = "Log of Average Flux (g/cm^3)",
       colour = "Site", fill = "Site", shape = "Site") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16)

# Manual prediction grid version (population-level, random effects at 0)
# Dist here must match distsitemodel's factor levels exactly, since
# that's how the model was actually fit -- using plain numeric (like
# the original file did) silently mismatches the model's expected
# input type instead of erroring, which is worse.
pred_grid <- expand.grid(
  Dist = factor(levels(avgdist$Dist), levels = levels(avgdist$Dist)),
  Site = unique(avgdist$Site),
  Tran = NA
)

preds_manual <- predict(distsitemodel, newdata = pred_grid,
                        re.form = ~0, se.fit = TRUE)

pred_grid$predicted <- preds_manual$fit
pred_grid$lower <- preds_manual$fit - 1.96 * preds_manual$se.fit
pred_grid$upper <- preds_manual$fit + 1.96 * preds_manual$se.fit

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = avgdist,
             aes(x = Dist, y = log(Flux), colour = Site, shape = Site),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = pred_grid,
            aes(x = Dist, y = predicted, colour = Site, group = Site),
            linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(data = pred_grid,
              aes(x = Dist, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = Site, group = Site),
              alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(x = "Distance (m)", y = "Log of Average Flux (g/cm^3)",
       colour = "Site", fill = "Site", shape = "Site") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 15))

```

```{r, transect x site model with replicate and phase}
# From Pre-Research_Questions.qmd's thesis_df_clean prep, rebuilt
# directly on master_tier5 -- removes NAs, negatives/zeros, and any
# non-finite values after log transform.

master_tier5_clean <- master_tier5[master_tier5$Flux > 0 &
                                     !is.na(master_tier5$Flux) &
                                     is.finite(log(master_tier5$Flux)), ]

sum(is.na(master_tier5_clean$Flux))
sum(master_tier5_clean$Flux <= 0)
nrow(master_tier5_clean)

master_tier5_clean$Tran <- as.factor(master_tier5_clean$Tran)
master_tier5_clean$Site <- as.factor(master_tier5_clean$Site)
master_tier5_clean$Replicate <- as.factor(master_tier5_clean$Replicate)
master_tier5_clean$Study.Phase <- factor(master_tier5_clean$Study.Phase,  levels = paste0("M", 1:12))

transite1 <- lmer(log(Flux) ~ Tran + Site + Tran*Site +
                    (1|Dist) + (1|Replicate) + (1|Study.Phase),
                  data = master_tier5_clean)
summary(transite1)

ggplot(master_tier5_clean, aes(x = as.factor(Tran), y = log(Flux), fill = Site, colour = Site)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_sina(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~Site, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Transect", y = "Log of Average Flux (g/cm^3/month)",
       fill = "Site", colour = "Site") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 12))

ggplot(master_tier5_clean, aes(x = as.factor(Study.Phase), y = log(Flux), color = Site)) +
```

```{r, marsh edge type and orientation model prep}

  # From Research_Questions.qmd's avgtotal -- Month included and
  # derived above (Research_Questions.qmd originally had it as a raw
  # column; here it's built from Date.removed.from.field instead).
  
  avgtotal <- aggregate(Flux ~ Site + Dist + Replicate + Month + Study.Phase +
                          marsh_orientation + marsh_edge_type,
                        data = master_tier5, FUN = mean)
  str(avgtotal)
  
  shapiro.test(avgtotal$Flux)
  shapiro.test(log(avgtotal$Flux))
  
  qqnorm(avgtotal$Flux)
  qqline(avgtotal$Flux)
  
  # Residual diagnostic for distsitemodel (built above) -- this only
  # resolves correctly because distsitemodel is now defined earlier in
  # this same file; it depended on Pre-Research_Questions.qmd having
  # already run in the same session in the original files.
  shapiro.test(resid(distsitemodel))
  qqnorm(resid(distsitemodel))
  qqline(resid(distsitemodel))


```

```{r, marsh edge type and orientation models}
marsh_edge_model_edge <- lmer(Flux ~ marsh_edge_type + (1|Dist), data = avgtotal)
summary(marsh_edge_model_edge)


marsh_edge_model_orient <- lmer(Flux ~ marsh_orientation + (1|Dist), data = avgtotal)
summary(marsh_edge_model_orient)

```
